name: asset-l10-dispersal-pipes-a
note: L10 dispersal pipes on the port grid: straight (left) meets the tee -X port, courier for scale. Look for: flanges touching without gap or overlap, saddles reach the ground, pipes not sunk. The game camera never zooms out past 1.0 (about 20 m across): pieces taller or wider than that are seen in part, which is the intended monumental read.
